# Roadmap: Forward Deployed Engineer

## Role overview

Engineer embedded with a customer to build and deploy the company's product (often AI) into the customer's real systems.

## Prerequisites

- [SQL](../topics/database-sql.md)
- [HTML](../topics/html.md)
- [Java](../topics/java.md)
- [Python](../topics/python.md)
- [REST API](../topics/rest-api.md)
- Usually 3+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [AI & LLMs](../topics/ai.md)
- [ ] [JavaScript](../topics/javascript.md)

### Stage 2: Frameworks and depth

- [ ] [React](../topics/react.md)
- [ ] [TypeScript](../topics/typescript.md)

## Also useful

[AWS](../topics/aws.md), [DevOps](../topics/devops.md), [Git](../topics/git.md)

## Also needed

LangGraph, Palantir Foundry/AIP, Jupyter, Postman, Customer data platforms

## Where it leads

Grow: AI Solutions Architect, Tech Lead · Lead: Engineering Manager · Pivot: AI Product Manager, Solutions / Sales Engineer
